LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 7.1.1 OBSERVING A SIGNED COMPREHENSION: OBSERVING FOR DETAILS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 7.1.1 Observing a signed Comprehension: Observing for Details
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 7.1.1 Observing a signed Comprehension: Observing for Details, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell the key information from a listening or sign read text? 2. How can you tell that people are listening attentively or observing keenly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating Signs (Listening and Speaking) 7.1.1 Observing a signed Comprehension: Observing for Details together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learner develops effective communication skills as they observe and note the clues signalling details from a peer.

● Communication and Collaboration: Learner develops the skill of teamwork as they role-play and make signed oral presentations.

Values:
● Patriotism: Learners develop the love for their own country as they make presentations and observe signed texts on natural resources,

thereby developing a sense of belonging.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate listening and observing skills to their learning in all other subjects such as Kenya Sign language, Agriculture

and Nutrition.
